speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma or Hodgkin Lymphoma).

I have requested your CBC, LDH, and Abdominal Ultrasound results to confirm bone marrow involvement and abdominal masses.
